g.text: MemForge automatic commits: memory-auto-commit.sh and memory-watch
keep absolute PATH entries only; find readlink
(a regular file, not a link), cat, jq, git, tr outside
[one is missing or inside a store, or no readlink qualifies]
cd to the store; unset GIT_DIR, GIT_WORK_TREE,
frontmatter fixes; the recall index is rewritten
locally as a cache and never staged (SC-41)
snoozes/, recall-synonyms.yaml. A file staged by hand
outside the scope stays staged. Commits are signed only
if the user's git config signs them.
no DLP scan before the commit
a hand-run git add -A still takes .memforge/
